items.body_excerpt:
Toumani Camara says the Blazers opened practice with a session where they went over their goals and ground rules for the season. Two of those goals:

50-plus wins and home court advantage in the playoffs.

items.title: Toumani Camara on Micah Nori: "The way he communicates with players, very upfront. He makes jokes, very easy to talk to. But when it's time for business, you know what he's about. Very detailed. You can tell right away the way he wants to play."
